hook.text: Excalibur proved Arthur's right to rule. Only the worthy could pull it from the stone.

buildup.text: Swords required skill to forge and wield. Owning one meant wealth, power, and status.

discovery.text: In Japanese tradition, the sword is one of three imperial regalia—alongside a mirror and a jewel.

twist.text: The same sword protects and conquers. Roland's Durandal and Siegfried's Balmung served both ends.

climax.text: We still knight people with swords today. The weapon became honor long after battles ended.

punchline.text: The blade cuts both ways. Always has.

quiz.question: What are the three Japanese imperial regalia?
